description:
**Figure Description: Stage 3 — Multi-Model Barrier Rating**

**Overall Layout:**
The diagram will feature a crisp white background and an aspect ratio of 4:3. The overall flow is strictly top-to-bottom, structured into three distinct tiers. The central Tier 2 clearly emphasizes three parallel, independent processing paths. All text will use a clean serif font similar to Georgia or Palatino. There will be no drop shadows, gradients, 3D effects, or decorative icons; the design will be flat and clean, embodying a "Soft Tech & Scientific Pastels" aesthetic.

**Tier 1: Input (Top Center)**
*   **Component:** A single rounded rectangle, centrally placed at the top of the diagram.
    *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 400 units wide by 50 units high.
    *   **Fill:** Crisp white.
    *   **Border:** A solid line in a distinct deep academic blue.
    *   **Main Label:** Centered within the box, "1,598 question pairs (1,030 CPS–ACS + 568 FoodAPS–ACS)".
        *   **Font:** Serif font, deep charcoal text.
    *   **Sublabel:** Centered below the main label, "Each pair: source question text + ACS question text + shared subtopic".
        *   **Font:** Italic serif font, soft, muted blue-grey text.

**Downward Arrow Split:**
*   A single, vertical, solid deep academic blue arrow originates from the bottom center of the Tier 1 input box.
*   This arrow descends a short distance and then splits into three equally spaced, parallel vertical arrows. Each of these three arrows is also a solid deep academic blue line, clearly indicating independent data flow to the three rater modules below.

**Tier 2: Three Independent Raters (Middle Section)**
This tier consists of three identical, vertically oriented rounded rectangles arranged horizontally, representing the independent raters. They are equally spaced across the width of the diagram below the split arrows.

*   **Rater 1: OpenAI (Left Column)**
    *   **Component:** A rounded rectangle.
        *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 260 units wide by 250 units high.
        *   **Fill:** A very pale, gentle sky blue.
        *   **Border:** A solid line in deep academic blue.
    *   **Header Bar:** A solid rectangle in deep academic blue, 30 units high, fixed at the top internal edge of the rater box.
        *   **Text:** Centered within the header bar, "Rater 1: OpenAI".
        *   **Font:** Bold serif font, crisp white text.
    *   **Body Content (inside the pale sky blue box, below the header):** All text is left-aligned.
        *   "Model: gpt-5-mini" (italic serif, soft, muted blue-grey).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   "For each pair, assign:" (serif font, deep charcoal text).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   **Small Inner Box 1 (Feasibility):** A small, crisp white filled rectangle with a fine, solid border in deep academic blue.
            *   **Label:** "Feasibility" (bold serif font, deep charcoal text).
            *   **Content:**
                *   "F1 = direct recode" (serif font, deep charcoal text).
                *   "F2 = statistical adjustment" (serif font, deep charcoal text).
                *   "F3 = incompatible" (serif font, deep charcoal text).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   **Small Inner Box 2 (Barrier code):** A small, crisp white filled rectangle with a fine, solid border in deep academic blue.
            *   **Label:** "Barrier code (if F3)" (bold serif font, deep charcoal text).
            *   **Content:** "CC TC RS PC MC PM" (serif font, deep charcoal text).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   **Small Inner Box 3 (Reasoning):** A small, crisp white filled rectangle with a fine, solid border in deep academic blue.
            *   **Label:** "Reasoning" (bold serif font, deep charcoal text).
            *   **Content:** "Free-text justification" (italic serif, soft, muted blue-grey).

*   **Rater 2: Anthropic (Center Column)**
    *   Identical structure, dimensions, fills, and borders as Rater 1.
    *   **Header Bar Text:** "Rater 2: Anthropic" (bold serif font, crisp white text).
    *   **Body Content:**
        *   "Model: claude-haiku-4-5" (italic serif, soft, muted blue-grey).
        *   All other internal labels and content are identical to Rater 1.

*   **Rater 3: Google (Right Column)**
    *   Identical structure, dimensions, fills, and borders as Rater 1.
    *   **Header Bar Text:** "Rater 3: Google" (bold serif font, crisp white text).
    *   **Body Content:**
        *   "Model: gemini-3-flash" (italic serif, soft, muted blue-grey).
        *   All other internal labels and content are identical to Rater 1.

*   **Separators and Grouping:**
    *   Between each rater column (i.e., between Rater 1 & 2, and Rater 2 & 3), a vertical dashed line in a soft cool grey extends downwards from just below the split arrows to above the converging arrows.
